about: The English messages of the phone's "Coming up" list (src/core/i18n/en.ts, home.upcoming.*, #267), each with sample values, and the new Home tile keys sit in their features' fixtures. test/unit/i18n/moved-strings.test.ts asserts that the French catalog renders what the rewrite layer makes of the English; `translated` is French where the layer left the English or got it wrong, a visible change #268 and #269 record when they draw these. The legacy panel still draws all of them until #268 and #269, so no entry of the rewrite layer is deleted yet. Deleted with the layer in phase 4.
